comment: The sync input takes a clock in two of the three modes and a 0-10V scan in the third, so it is left without a family. SYNC is read differently by each clock mode on the Blank it feeds: in sync and frame modes it is a trigger, and in scan mode the voltage itself is the position in the animation, so no step or range is written for it.
